rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Blurred bedside table, warm off-white, lamp in far corner
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a softly blurred bedside table scene in warm off-white #F4F2EE tones, evoking a quiet night routine: the plain tabletop runs along the bottom, a single small round lamp shade is a distant out-of-focus pale shape in the far top-left corner only. Lighting: low warm lamplight at 3000K from the upper left mixed with faint cool 6000K ambient fill, shadows falling to the lower right. Background: very low detail, shallow depth at f/2.8, no objects on the table. Style: clinical editorial restraint. The left half of the frame is intentionally empty, an even low-detail field for headline copy added later. The right 45% of the frame is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
